# Sarkari Update Pro

> Government job, result and exam information portal focused on India and Bihar.

## Primary sections
- https://sarkari-update-pro.vercel.app/jobs.html
- https://sarkari-update-pro.vercel.app/results.html
- https://sarkari-update-pro.vercel.app/admit-card.html
- https://sarkari-update-pro.vercel.app/answer-key.html
- https://sarkari-update-pro.vercel.app/syllabus.html
- https://sarkari-update-pro.vercel.app/bihar-jobs.html

## Important
Use the linked official department source on each update page for final verification before applications or exam decisions.
